built_in_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a production-ready transparent PNG ENEMY SPRITE ATLAS for the pixel JRPG "一路向東". Generate ONE square sprite sheet, 1536×1536 preferred (1024×1024 acceptable), EXACTLY 4 equally-sized columns by 4 equally-sized rows. Each cell contains exactly one of the sixteen specified enemy sprites, centered, wholly inside its cell, with at least 12% transparent padding on every side. Feet/base at 86% of that cell's height. No frames, no dividing grid, no text, no numbers, no logos. True alpha transparency outside each sprite, not a painted checkerboard or white background.
Input image 1 is STYLE AND WORLD reference only: detailed painterly pixel clusters, warm metallic glints, purple-black alien occupation technology with glowing amber cores, alien infestation of a devastated Earth. Do NOT include any scenery, road, buildings, sky or ground from the reference.
Art direction: sophisticated late-16-bit JRPG battle sprites, each designed at about 96×96 logical pixel density and enlarged with crisp stepped pixels. Fine selective highlights, material-specific pixel clusters, directional lighting from upper left, dimensional forms, rich shading, no smooth vector look, no flat polygon illustrations, no generic block people. Detailed expressive silhouettes viewed from the front / slight three-quarter battle stance, facing the player. Consistent palette and light across all 16. Full body, claws, wings, weapons, antennae, and tentacles fully visible and contained within their cell. Use asymmetrical authored poses. No adjacent sprites overlap or touch.
Exact row-major order:
ROW 1: (1) HUMAN ROAD RAIDER: patched rust-brown traveling coat, wrapped scarf masking lower face, rough boots, scavenged pistol, human face, dynamic threatening pose. (2) OCCUPATION SOLDIER: sleek purple-black curved biomechanical armor, amber horizontal eye slit and amber thorax core, alien energy rifle, thin athletic alien silhouette. (3) RAGING MUTANT: hulking olive-gray skin, uneven muscular body, bony shoulder growths, ripped surviving clothes, clenched claws, small glowing eyes. (4) INFECTED HOST: gaunt gray human with ripped red-brown jacket, hunched staggering posture, purple parasitic growth at shoulder/head, no graphic gore.
ROW 2: (5) PARASITIC CRAWLER: low six-legged purple-black arthropod, segmented armored abdomen, curling tail, hooks and amber eyes, much wider than tall. (6) MUTANT HOUND: lean four-legged alien infected dog, sinewy rust-gray fur, exposed bony ridge, toothy narrow muzzle, clawed paws, unmistakably canine. (7) BROOD MOTHER: plump rooted alien organism, translucent purple egg sacs, softly luminous amber inner organ, four curling root limbs, looming nurturing-horrific silhouette. (8) SPORE SWARM: ONE compact group of five small flying parasitic insects with tiny translucent wings and olive/amber bioluminescent abdomens, group wholly contained in its cell.
ROW 3: (9) PATROL DRONE: hovering alien crescent drone with curved purple-black wing arms, amber optics, delicate segmented underside and fine engine detail; no human body. (10) DEFENSE TURRET: alien tripod base with articulated clawed feet, long organic-tech energy cannon, amber target lens, purple-black ribbed armored shell. (11) ROGUE WORKER ROBOT: broad labor mech with industrial wear, bulky shoulders, one pincer and one heavy tool arm, two articulated legs, purple occupation circuitry and amber chest core. (12) ALIEN SENTINEL: tall imposing elite guard with swept horn-like carapace crown, layered purple-black armor, amber seams and core, ornate forearm shield, recognizably alien rather than a human soldier.
ROW 4: (13) LURKER: very tall slender shadowy purple organism, long bent limbs, hooked claws, narrow luminous eyes, crouched predatory silhouette. (14) CARAPACE BEHEMOTH: massive low four-legged reptile/insect hybrid, heavy moss-green overlapping armor plates, large swept spikes and broad jaw, weighty anatomical silhouette. (15) MUTANT FLIER: bat-like alien with wide purple membrane wings, bony amber-veined finger supports, small body and hooked feet, wings spread, contained within cell. (16) PARASITIC TENTACLE: upright many-tentacled alien rooted creature, curling limbs around a single fleshy luminous amber core, moist purple/pink chitin details.
All sixteen subjects must be distinguishable by silhouette and appearance. The background is entirely transparent; only the sixteen sprites are visible.
layout_correction_prompt:
Edit this enemy sprite atlas ONLY to correct the cell layout and transparent spacing. Preserve the precise designs, pixel-art texture, all colors and details of every one of the 16 enemies, and preserve their current row-major order. Do not redesign the creatures.
Output a square PNG with REAL ALPHA TRANSPARENCY. EXACT 4 equally-sized columns × 4 equally-sized rows, no grid lines or labels. Inside EACH cell, uniformly scale the existing sprite down enough that its full alpha silhouette occupies at most 76% of the cell width and 74% of the cell height. Center it horizontally, with the bottommost visible pixel on a baseline at 86% of the cell height; leave at least 12% of that cell totally empty transparent on the left, right, top and bottom. This padding is critical. Do not let any wing, tail, claw, weapon, glow, effect, or shadow approach a cell boundary. The wide carapace beast and bat in the bottom row must be shrunk within their respective cells, not cropped. Each individual enemy must stay separate. For the swarm keep its insects together as one compact sprite in row 2 column 4. Keep every creature complete and fully visible. No scenery, no white/black/colored/checkerboard background, no coloured backdrop effects, no new smoke or added shadows. Preserve original late-16-bit painterly pixel-art look and fine material shading.
